title: 05/23/2025 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: 05/23/2025 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000104585 We made updates to several default widgets this week. If you customized any of these widgets and want to update them, you can find the latest code in the corresponding default widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, the latest updates will not be pushed to your website. Updated the layout of the "Login Page Signup Buttons" Menu used on the /login page of sites. Fixed an issue that prevented the Form Manager from saving "cloned" form fields or setting a form field as "Admin Only" in some cases. Updated the default homepage canonical URL to include a trailing slash so it matches the default homepage URL format used in the .htaccess file. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD Fixed an issue that prevented the "3rd Party Lead Matched Notifications (SMS)" Lead Settings from working properly when manually matching leads to members from the Admin in some cases. Fixed an issue with saving Member Sub-Categories when both Top-Level and Sub-Level Categories were selected in the same Member Dashboard form. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Select Categories Created a new Webhook called "Lead Accept / Decline" , which triggers when a member accepts or declines a lead from the Member Dashboard. Fixed an issue with the keyword search on the Private Chat page in the Admin. The " Pending Admin Invites" are now displayed on the Admin Accounts page in the Admin area. Additionally, admins can now resend the invite email or revoke the invitation directly from this page. Fixed an issue that prevented the system from saving the state and city information when manually geocoding members from the Search Members page in the Admin. Updated the Domain Manager page in the Admin to include CNAME Record as a connection method in the domain transfer wizard. Additionally, the A Record connection method has been deprecated. Fixed an issue when saving the "Streaming Digital Product Title" Design Setting in the Admin. Fixed an issue that was preventing the Post category link on post search results from working properly in some cases. Post Type Involved: Classifieds Community Articles Coupons Digital Products Discussions Job Listings Photo Albums Products Audio Files Videos Fixed an issue with the keyword search on the Advanced Settings page in the Admin. Fixed an issue with bulk deleting members from the Search Members page in the Admin in some cases. Updated the Leads API logic to support string-based category names when automatically matching members with leads via the API. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
